name: f1-dev-tools
description: Reproduce, inspect, compare and validate Apex 26 camera and replay changes using the game's existing developer interface.

interface.longDescription: Five development workflows for brycejmurrin/f1-game: scene reproduction, camera inspection, before/after comparisons, WATCH replay transition checks, and camera preset preview/export. Includes browser helpers and a report generator; uses the existing Apex and browser tooling in a game checkout.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use F1 Dev Tools to reproduce and inspect a camera or replay problem in f1-game, then validate the change with matching render traces.
